author: reek
body: Port I/O carries the Device.Port capability effect, so every port call is an act-bind and each function that reaches one declares the row.

author: reek
body: A DirLight's vector points from the surface toward the light, not the way the light travels: the shader binds it straight to to-light and takes its dot with the normal. The two keys here therefore point up. They used to point down, which put the sun underground and left every upward face -- the whole ground plane included -- on ambient alone.

author: reek
body: The command buffer carries a depth per vertex and the rasterizer interpolates across the triangle. This used to write one averaged depth to all three slots, which turns a triangle into a flat card held at a single distance. On small triangles that is invisible; on the ground plane, which spans the whole scene, it made a billboard that occluded whatever it happened to average in front of.

author: reek
body: A lit surface keeps its own colour: the diffuse term is the albedo times the light, not the light alone. Scaling the bare light colour by the Lambert term, as this did, makes every lit face the colour of the lamp and leaves the material visible only in the quarter of the pixel that ambient contributes, so a blue cube under a white key light comes out white.
